meta.name: LM Lettering
meta.units: integers; ink cap height = 1000, y up, origin at the glyph origin with side bearings; strokes are pen centre lines: line (polyline), arc (centre, r, a0->a1 in degrees to one decimal, counter-clockwise if a1>a0), bezier (cubic, 4 points)
meta.source: Routed Gothic by Darren Embry (https://webonastick.com/fonts/routed-gothic/), traced from a Leroy lettering template; converted from the src/vector tracings (and the SFD source for the 7)

..notes: our measured reconstruction, centred in Routed Gothic's advance:

7.notes: from the SFD source (no tracing): midline of the thin outline

±.notes: our measured reconstruction, centred in Routed Gothic's advance: 3 samples, all LDW280-23631 sh3

℄.notes: centre-line symbol drawn in the manner of the Leroy lettering: a C open to the right overlapped by an L, stem on the C's centre, foot along the baseline

▲.notes: filled flag triangle (flag notes): the outline and three concentric triangles about the incentre, 85 units apart, closer than the narrowest pen, so the strokes fill it

✓.notes: check mark, drawn by eye in the font's manner from the lettered one in LDW280-17619 sheet 3's ops block (NOTES CHECKED ✓ APPLY): a short tick nearly upright down to the baseline, 0.55 cap tall, and a long stroke rising to the right at about 30 degrees to 0.62 cap; 1.16 cap wide (that one is 1.2: narrowed to keep the font's grid, whose step the widest glyph sets), its right bearing 110

⊠.notes: the marking-region symbol (U+22A0 SQUARED TIMES), lettered in a note that points at the region marked on the part (LDW280-17619 sheet 3: RUBBER STAMP PART NUMBER AND ALL OTHER MARKINGS IN REGION MARKED ⊠): a rectangle and both its diagonals, from the baseline to the cap height, 1.16 cap wide; that one is the region's own shape, about 5 cap wide and 1.35 tall, narrowed to the check mark's width to keep the font's grid, whose step the widest glyph sets
